test_title: PYST 16: SSC MTS 2024 - Reasoning Ability and Problem Solving (Held On: 15 Oct, 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
This question has two statements followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. You have to take the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. You have to decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the given statements.

Statements:

Some stones are hurting.

Some stones are beautiful.

Conclusions:

(I) Some beautiful stones are hurting.

(II) Some hurting stones are beautiful
solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c4d518d2f95874191034ea993a658a87434477a11852b8b7aa3dad88b435f351.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) Some beautiful stones are hurting → **Does not** follow (As re statement can not be true)

(II) Some hurting stones are beautiful → Does not follow (As some stones are hurting and some stones are beautiful. As some part of beautiful is common with stones which has some part common with hurting, so it is possible but not definite.)

∴ Here, **Neither conclusion (I) nor (II) follows**.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2"
